answer_text: Vault recommends a hierarchical CA setup where a root certificate issues one or more intermediates based on usage, and those intermediates issue leaf certificates. Different intermediates can be issued for different usages, such as VPN signing, email signing, or testing versus production TLS services, which keeps CRLs limited to specific purposes. Separate intermediates also allow higher-risk intermediates to have HSM-backing without impacting the performance of easier-to-rotate intermediates and certificates.
